experiment: §52 stage 0: screen of readers below 3B (laptop, CPU fp32, $0)
spec: research/proposals/2026-11-04-exp52-small-readers.md rev 0 (094cc5e), D-74; scope relayed by the Advisor 2026-11-08
gemma270m_role: optional floor (proposal); screened and gated like the others

primary.rule: jacobian_data.family_population on the §24 fixed8 records (answerable, all evidence in view, >=1 evidence line, §24 judge label present); the §43 stage-0 126 rows, identical in Llama/Gemma/Phi

secondary.use: descriptive only (the 'unknown' rate when the evidence is not all in view); run after every reader's primary set

prompt.chat: each model's own template, one user turn, no system message added (families.chat_text); Llama date pinned to 09 Oct 2026; Qwen and SmolLM2 templates insert their own default system text

measures.answer: answer_selection.agent_answer(text): the phrase after the last 'answer:' (empty -> 'unknown'), the whole output when there is no marker (the §23 grading)
measures.marker_rate: share of the 126 primary rows with a marker (agent_answer(text)[1])
measures.in_view_abstention: among marked primary rows (all evidence in view by construction), share with is_refusal_answer(answer) (starts with 'unknown'); k reported
measures.reading_floor: share of the 126 primary rows with answer_selection.d1(answer, gold) True (normalised gold string or every gold token in the answer; None counts False); the marked-only version is descriptive

descriptive.unknown_not_in_view: is_refusal_answer among marked secondary rows that are answerable and not all in view (and, separately, the unanswerable rows)
descriptive.note_then_refuse: share of in-view abstentions with d1(note, gold) True (the §49 signature)
descriptive.refusal_phrase_count: primary rows with utilmem.is_refusal(answer) True but is_refusal_answer False (§24 phrases)

gate.rule: a reader is queued only if all three hold

fail_labels.marker: does not follow the format; not measurable here
fail_labels.floor: barely reads; an 'unknown' can't be read as an evidence-use failure
fail_labels.abstention: habit absent (or below the line) at this size

gate.queue_cap: at most two readers to Q-A..Q-D; order: highest in-view abstention, then the family not yet covered (none approved here)

stopping: D-45: a failed gate is documented, not rescued; no prompt tuning, no re-decoding
timing_rule: one full row per reader timed before any duration is quoted (measure-before-ETA)
